definitions.explanation: A criminal sentence requiring confinement in prison, typically involving mandatory labor.

examples.japanese: {懲役|ちょうえき}3⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A sentence of three years' imprisonment was handed down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{懲役|ちょうえき}5⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧、⟦{執行猶予|しっこうゆうよ}→執行猶予：18434_shikkouyuuyo⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The defendant was sentenced to five years' imprisonment, suspended.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{懲役|ちょうえき}10⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実刑|じっけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}い{渡|わた}された→言い渡す：07002_iiwatasu⟧。
examples.english: The man arrested for fraud was sentenced to ten years of actual imprisonment.

notes:
USAGE:
In the Japanese legal system, {懲役|ちょうえき} involves imprisonment with mandatory labor, as distinguished from ⟦{禁錮|きんこ}→禁錮：19211_kinko⟧ (imprisonment without labor). It is the most common form of custodial sentence in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {懲役|ちょうえき}〜⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (~ years' imprisonment)
- {懲役|ちょうえき}{刑|けい} (prison sentence)
- {実刑|じっけい} (actual prison time, as opposed to a suspended sentence)
- ⟦{執行猶予|しっこうゆうよ}→執行猶予：18434_shikkouyuuyo⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ (with suspended execution)

NOTE ON SENTENCING:
{懲役|ちょうえき}3⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧、⟦{執行猶予|しっこうゆうよ}→執行猶予：18434_shikkouyuuyo⟧5⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ means the prison term is suspended for 5 years — the person does not go to prison unless they commit another offense during that period.
